Madras HC questions election voiding over asset non-disclosure

The Madras High Court has questioned the assertion that an alleged non-disclosure of assets by politician Vijay could lead to the voiding of his election. The court is scheduled to deliver its orders on October 14 regarding a plea that challenges Vijay's election victory in Perambur.
